onChange.script:
logger = system.util.getLogger("BOM/Modules/Repeater.flex.instances")
	logger.info("Repeater change origin = " + origin)

	if currentValue.quality.isGood() and origin == 'Browser':
		# Use 'IA' as vendor for 'Standard', 'Edge', or 'Cloud'
		if self.view.params.vendor in ('Standard', 'Edge', 'Cloud'):
			vendor = 'IA'
		else:
			vendor = self.view.params.vendor

		# Sample Session Prop
		#self.session.custom.structure.configs.I2feea8ee.config.modules.IA

		# Build list of dictionaries
		moduleList = []
		#logger.info(str(len(currentValue.value)))
		for i in range(len(currentValue.value)):
			module = currentValue.value[i].value
			#logger.info(str(module))
			#logger.info(str(currentValue.value[i]))
			moduleDict = {'name': module['name'].value}
			#logger.info(str(moduleDict))
			if 'selection' in currentValue.value[i].value.keys():
				#logger.info("Found 'selection'")
				if currentValue.value[i].value['selection'].value not in (None, 'null', 'None'):
					moduleDict['selection'] = currentValue.value[i].value['selection'].value
					logger.info("New Selection value = " + moduleDict['selection'])
			moduleList.append(moduleDict)

		logger.info(str(moduleList))

		# Get structure
		structure = system.util.jsonDecode(system.util.jsonEncode(self.session.custom.structure))
		
		logger.info("Original config for " + self.view.params.uuid + " was " + str(structure['configs'][self.view.params.uuid]['config']['modules'][vendor]))

		logger.info("Altering config for " + self.view.params.uuid + "; New value = " + str(moduleList))

		# Alter this config
		structure['configs'][self.view.params.uuid]['config']['modules'][vendor] = moduleList
		structure['source'] = 'bom'

		logger.info("Local 'structure' updated: " + self.view.params.uuid + "/" + vendor + " = " + str(structure['configs'][self.view.params.uuid]['config']['modules'][vendor]))

		# Write updates back to session property
		self.session.custom.structure = structure

		# Call message handler to update total cost displayed in header
		logger.info("Calling 'updateCost' from FlexRepeater.props.instances")
		system.perspective.sendMessage("priceRefresh", {'vendor': vendor, 'uuid': self.view.params.uuid})
